products.name: AI Model Testing & Scenario-Based Evaluation Harness (Safe Pre-Production) — Commercial
products.short_description: Build an AI model testing and scenario-based evaluation harness — scenarios, metrics, synthetic/twin test data, and pass/fail gates — so AI is evaluated safely and consistently before production. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Evaluate AI models against scenarios before you ship them

AI teams need to prove a model is safe and useful before production — against realistic, repeatable scenarios, not one-off demos. This solution builds an AI model testing and scenario-based evaluation harness: define evaluation scenarios and metrics, run models against synthetic/twin data, capture results with pass/fail gates, and make the whole thing reusable — so AI is evaluated safely and consistently before broader adoption.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run Python tooling.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the evaluation model: scenarios, metrics, test data (synthetic/twin), pass/fail gates, and reusability.
  • Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (synthetic/twin data, model access, evaluation metrics, isolated environment, use cases).
  • Implementation Guide — define evaluation scenarios + metrics, wire the model and synthetic/twin data, run evaluations with pass/fail gates, capture results, and make the harness reusable, pilot-first.
  • 5 Python tools — assessment/profiling, generation or scenario execution, a fidelity/coverage report, a privacy/validation check, and a scope/config helper — authentic to synthetic-data engineering (safe by default; no real PHI written to shared locations).
  • Testing/validation gates (scenarios run, metrics captured, gates enforced) plus Best Practices for repeatable, comparable evaluation.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

AI models proven against realistic scenarios with clear pass/fail gates — evaluated safely and comparably before broader adoption — with a reusable harness the org keeps.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • Automation Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • eval_scope_assess.py — profile readiness/scope for the AI evaluation harness (read-only)
    • harness_config.py — scaffold/validate the harness config + asset skeletons; manage the baseline
    • metrics_reporter.py — aggregate a Run Record and enforce the Evaluation Gate Policy (PASS/FAIL)
    • regression_check.py — compare a Run Record to the approved baseline and verify the safety boundary
    • scenario_runner.py — run scenarios against a Model Under Test adapter and record metrics

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all Python scripts and tools in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
